title: Teething Rings Recalled by Calisson Due to Ingestion Hazard

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts and Jackets With Drawstrings Recalled by Hot Kids Due to Strangulation Hazard

summary: A component in the dehumidifier's compressor can short circuit, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 198,000.

title: Infant and Toddler Footed Pajamas Recalled by Pajamagram Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal snaps that attach the hood to pajamas can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 800.

summary: The tank's controller can overheat and melt, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 67,000.

summary: The plastic balls on the butterfly's wings can break, causing small metal balls inside to come free. These metal balls pose choking and aspiration hazards to young children. Units: About 1,440.

summary: When folding and unfolding the stroller, a consumer's finger can become caught in the hinge mechanism, posing amputation and laceration hazards. Units: About 22,000 in the United States and 7,200 in Canada.

summary: Some of this propane does not have sufficient levels of the odorant that is added to propane to help alert consumers to a gas leak. Failure to detect leaking gas can present fire, explosion and thermal burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 700 rail cars.

title: Food Dehydrator Recalled by NESCO American Harvest Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A defective capacitor in the electronic control module can overheat, posing a smoke and fire hazard. Units: About 4,800.

title: Frontgate Recalls Step Ladders Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The ladders can unexpectedly break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 38,000.

title: IKEA Recalls Glass Mugs Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The inner walls of the double-walled glasses can break during use, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,000 (an additional 115,000 were sold outside the U.S., including 3,000 in Canada).

title: Poulan Pro Generators Recalled by Husqvarna Professional Products Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The carburetor can fail allowing gasoline to leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 600.

title: LED Lamps Recalled by Eco-Story Due to Fire Hazard
summary: When used without a Class II transformer, the lamp can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 42,000.

summary: Improper plastic material found inside the recalled product has been attributed to vacuum release failures which create an entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 1,600.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to a Loss of Control Hazard
summary: The front lower suspension arm can crack during use which could lead to loss of control, posing a risk of severe injury or death. Units: About 16,500.

summary: A component of the inverter can degrade, causing out gassing within the wiring compartment of the inverter. summary: Small pieces of the plastic ball can detach as a result of children chewing on the teether/rattle, posing an ingestion hazard. Units: About 37,000.
